metadata.analysis: Mahomes threw for 300 yards without a turnover and looked unbothered by the knee that cost him the preseason.
metadata.description: Patrick Mahomes completed 25 of 35 passes for 300 yards and three touchdowns in the opener.
metadata.title: Patrick Mahomes - Three scores in opener

metadata.analysis: Reid said the knee is behind Mahomes and that there is no snap count for Week 2.
metadata.description: Chiefs head coach Andy Reid said Patrick Mahomes carries no injury designation into Week 2.
metadata.title: Patrick Mahomes - No designation for Week 2
